tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Satisfactorily completed as prime supplier/tenderer, at least one similar goods and services such as Providing Food Catering services and/or running food canteen of value not less than Rs: 226.30 Lakhs in the last five years i.e., 2021-22 to 2025-26, (Past Experience shall be certified by officer rank not below Project director or executive engineer)
The tenderer/firms/individuals should have Registered with the Concerned Statutory Authorities (Tenderer needs to submit a registration certificate from the competent authority)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Firm Registration or Relevant document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer/firms/individuals should have minimum three years of experience in the field of cooking and catering/ Canteen Services.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Turnover certificate/registration certificate/or relevant document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer/firms/individuals should have registered with 1 .Labour Department(Labour Licenses) 2. Regional Provident Fund Commissioner for Provident Fund(PF) 3. Employees State Insurance Corporation (ESI) 4. Certificate under Food Safety Act

Achieved in at least one financial years a minimum annual financial turnover of Rs:905.20 lakhs of the estimate cost in (catering/restaurant business only) the last five years i.e., 2021-22 to 2025-26
